status: Source-bound implementation preparation only; no app/test edits or runtime proof

observedFacts.finding: Returns Void; early unavailable/disconnected return leaves shared today unchanged. Eighteen async readings use one start/end window and then unconditionally assign shared today/status after awaiting all results.

Current raw query helpers already return HealthMetricReading with healthQuery.start/end/checkedAt and recorded/noData/failed distinctions. Preserve that information; read permission cannot be inferred from empty results.

Captures HealthBackgroundSync generation, awaits Void refreshToday, checks generation and authorization, then reads shared hk.today. Requires a valid .today boundary before save; unavailable cache cannot be repaired through this normal save path.

The current daily-cache domain has no legacy UserDefaults key. Do not invent or silently migrate a today legacy key. Existing meals/workouts/goals legacy behavior and failed bytes remain part of the original overall scope.
Empty uses legacy nil readings/recordedTotalKeys with numeric placeholders. Explicit clear/rebuild unknown state needs readings=[:] and recordedTotalKeys=[] bound to the captured day.

Generic record replacement rotates journal.lifecycle and writes the new journal. Old save events then fail lifecycle equality in next/contains/pendingEvents, while deletions remain eligible. Reusing this generic payload for a cache-only rebuild/clear would withdraw unrelated pending saves.

Generic guard requires every chosen domain unavailable. A genuinely missing today file is successfully loaded with a missing boundary and therefore available; the generic unavailable-only entry is not an absent-cache route.

Lower-level checked recovery preparation accepts supplied replacement files independently of HealthRecoverySelection journal rotation, preserves prior conversation-copy protections and failed replaced-domain bytes, and clones unrelated files. A cache-specific caller can share these primitives without rewriting the journal.

inferencesNotRuntimeClaims: A separate recovery caller must obtain the exact returned observation for its operation rather than reading the shared today property after a Void await. Concurrent refresh completion can otherwise make operation ownership ambiguous; no new concurrent runtime reproduction is claimed here.

A source-generation check at the HealthStore caller does not prevent the service itself publishing late today/status after disconnect. Query publication and recovery installation both need captured ownership checks.

implementationDecisions.direction: Extract a query operation returning its own raw DayMetrics and captured start/end/source-generation token. Keep ordinary refresh as a wrapper which publishes only while its captured source session remains current. Recovery consumes the returned value and never a previously published property.

Bind actual HKQuery handles and exactly-once continuation completion to the operation. Cancel/Back must stop or detach owned queries safely; check ownership after each await and again before installation. Do not weaken MainActor/generation/commit locks or use a synthetic successful read as actual Health evidence.

Implement a cache-specific checked transaction using lower-level ConversationFiles.prepareHealthRecovery/BackupFileTransaction preservation and LocalStore revision/commit guards. Do not route cache-only operations through HealthRecoverySelection.prepare, which rotates the Health-write lifecycle. Keep journal bytes/lifecycle/claim eligibility unchanged; revalidate current failed-source identity/root/revision/device owner/day/source token under existing locks. Store raw observations only; explicit clear remains a separate confirmed action.

Unavailable/disconnected does not silently clear. A successful no-data query yields unknown with its query metadata. Partial failed queries retain distinct failed metadata and require truthful review; a failed rebuild never falls through to clear.

requiredFocusedEvidence: Held two overlapping query operations return their own raw values despite reversed completion; stale operation cannot publish or install.
Seed shared today with an old positive reading, then unavailable/disconnected query; rebuild must never reuse that value.
Disconnect/reconnect, reset, local write, day rollover and newer operation during actual held query/preparation reject late mutation; Cancel and Back are independently observed.
Returned zero remains recorded, empty/no-data remains unknown, failed differs from no-data; explicit clear does not fabricate measured zeros.
Persist/relaunch raw source observations with local/imported/sleep values added once; exact unrelated current/prior/failed raw bytes and receipts remain preserved.

Seed pending save, pending deletion, partial acknowledgement and in-flight claimed Health events; cache-only rebuild and clear must keep exact journal bytes/lifecycle and pending/contains/next semantics, without a fabricated external acknowledgement.

For truly absent today.json, prove an explicit separate action reaches reviewed recovery while ordinary available/unavailable guards remain intact. Healthy-cache replacement still requires its own explicit decision; do not weaken generic unavailable record-replacement checks.
scope: Additive source-bound preparation for full daily-cache implementation after Source131 producer/critic freeze. Nine source identities captured; generic record replacement journal rotation is deliberately not reused for cache-only actions. No app/test change/runtime proof. Full parent requirements/sixareas/remainingScope/eightgroups/product/physical-device/VoiceOver/publication unchanged.
